`__rt_is_dir` is the wrapper guard and `__rt_is_dir_core` the body, declared as a second global a
few instructions later; the guard branches over the refusal into it. On macOS every global starts
its own SUBSECTION (`.subsections_via_symbols`), and that branch — resolved by the assembler inside
one section — carries NO relocation. The linker therefore sees nothing referencing the core,
